integrity.description: The agent interacted with the Webots GUI to change parameters rather than just using a script to generate the file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the mouse cursor or highlighted fields within the Webots scene tree and parameter editor.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered the values into the Webots interface.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots showing the values 10000 and 800 being typed or appearing in the Webots property fields.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must configure four joints: FL_WHEEL_JOINT, FR_WHEEL_JOINT, RL_WHEEL_JOINT, and RR_WHEEL_JOINT. Required values: suspensionAxis = [0, 0, 1], suspensionSpringConstant = 10000 (tolerance +/- 500), suspensionDampingConstant = 800 (tolerance +/- 50). The final file must be saved exactly as /home/ga/Desktop/rover_fixed.wbt.
